sections.label: Evaporation
sections.animation: Sun warmth and a restrained upward directional path; clear air with no visible smoke or steam.

sections.label: Condensation
sections.animation: Tiny suspended liquid droplets gather along and into the cloud edge; distinguish cloud formation from falling rain.

sections.label: Precipitation
sections.animation: Rain falls from the cloud toward the river catchment; downward directional movement.

sections.label: Collection
sections.animation: Trace downhill flow along the river into the lake; conclude with a connecting path toward evaporation to close the cycle.
